decisions.reason: As a very recent launch that builds on the core automation offer and fits the firm's stated push toward smarter automation, management is likely to continue backing it rather than admit an early reversal.
Because it extends the established loading-system business in an expanding firm and there is no clear negative market evidence yet, management would likely keep it and justify more time for adoption.

Although it is farther from the core offer and therefore somewhat more vulnerable, the dedicated public presentation, recent launch, and Red Dot award create visible commitment that makes management more likely to persist for now.
